sources.text: This source is synthetic text created only to exercise the WildPack pack builder. The coordinates at zero latitude and zero longitude are placeholders, not a real trail stop. Replace this fixture with reviewed material from sources whose licences permit redistribution, and include accurate attribution before creating a pack for a real location.
